definitions.explanation: A specific instance or occurrence of something happening. Used to count occurrences or refer to a particular instance.
When followed by に, indicates 'every time that ~' or 'whenever ~'. A very common grammatical pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{度|たび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おめでとうございます→おめでとうございます：30847_omedetougozaimasu⟧。
⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I remember every time I see it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{度重|たびかさ}なる→度重なる：31688_tabikasanaru⟧⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was warned for being late again and again.
examples.notes: ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧ = this time, next time

examples.english: I feel energized every time I meet him.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{度|たび}、⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりました→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: We will be opening a new shop in front of the station.
examples.notes: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ = many times

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つける→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Every time I go to Japan, I find a new shop.

notes:
USAGE: Most often used in the pattern 〜{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ "every time ~." Often written in kana: たび⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [dictionary form / N⟦の→の：09472_no⟧] + {度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: every time ~ (⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{度|たび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧)
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{度|たび}: on this occasion (formal; announcements and greetings)
- ⟦{度重|たびかさ}なる→度重なる：31688_tabikasanaru⟧: repeated, one after another
- {度々|たびたび}: often, frequently

WATCH OUT:
- With numbers and in most compounds, 度 is read ど, not たび: ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧, ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧, ⟦{今度|こんど}→今度：01327_kondo⟧, ⟦{毎度|まいど}→毎度：00266_maido⟧.
- ⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧ "journey" has the same reading.
